svg.metadata: {"story":"Jacob","act":7,"chapter":"Ch.7 · Leaving Haran","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Jacob flees Laban by night; Rachel hides the teraphim in a saddle and sits on them; the two camps meet on the hill of Gilead.
